title: Light Through Leaves
description: Dappled sunlight filtered through a leafy canopy swaying in the wind. Several leaf-gap layers sit at different focal planes — a sharp near layer and blurrier far ones — and are stacked by multiplication, so their drifting gap patterns beat into the shifting moiré ripple you see in real dappled light where the near and far foliage cross. Soft shadows and bright light-pools of varying focus sway across a live image; the colour temperature slides from cool blue-white shade to warm golden sun (with complementary cool shadows), and the focal-plane spread, canopy density, wind, softness and contrast are all live.
